title: Google AI Makes a Big Move: Image and Video Watermarks Can Finally Be Removed!

content_html:
Google has recently released a new feature that has caught the attention of both creators and regular users. According to official announcements, users will be able to choose to turn off visible watermarks when generating images, videos, and even music in the future.

This new feature was first revealed by Josh Woodward, the head of Google Gemini, on a social platform. It is reported that this new toggle setting will gradually be rolled out to multiple models such as Nano Banana, Omni, and Lyria. For everyday use scenarios, the feature will first be available on the Gemini web version and Google's own video editing software Flow, and then gradually expand to search services.

However, turning off visible watermarks does not mean complete freedom. Google has found a balance between creative freedom and security: while visible watermarks can be turned off, underlying invisible protection measures remain active. In other words, invisible watermarks like SynthID and related C2PA standard metadata will continue to be retained to ensure content transparency.

In other words, if users want to verify whether an image or video was generated by artificial intelligence, they can still use Gemini or related search tools for identification.

For many users who incorporate AI-generated content into their daily professional creation and design work, removing visible watermarks can greatly reduce post-processing hassle. This update is currently being rolled out in stages. Once the feature is fully launched, users can simply go to the media watermark option in settings to freely switch between displaying or turning off the watermark. At the same time, Google has also open-sourced a local verification development library called Credentio, making it easier for developers to embed local verification mechanisms into their own applications.

content_html_zh:
谷歌最近发布了一项新功能，引起了创作者和普通用户的关注。 据官方公布，未来用户在生成图像、视频甚至音乐时将可以选择关闭可见水印。

这项新功能最早由 Google Gemini 负责人 Josh Woodward 在社交平台上透露。 据悉，这一新的切换设置将逐步推广到 Nano Banana、Omni、Lyria 等多款车型上。 对于日常使用场景，该功能将首先在 Gemini 网页版和谷歌自家视频编辑软件 Flow 上提供，然后逐步扩展到搜索服务。

然而，关闭可见水印并不意味着完全的自由。 谷歌在创作自由和安全之间找到了平衡：虽然可见水印可以关闭，但潜在的隐形保护措施仍然有效。 换句话说，像SynthID这样的隐形水印和相关的C2PA标准元数据将继续保留，以确保内容透明度。

也就是说，如果用户想要验证某个图像或视频是否是人工智能生成的，仍然可以使用Gemini或相关搜索工具进行识别。

对于许多将人工智能生成的内容融入日常专业创作和设计工作的用户来说，去除可见水印可以大大减少后期处理的麻烦。 此更新目前正在分阶段推出。 该功能全面上线后，用户只需前往设置中的媒体水印选项即可自由切换显示或关闭水印。 同时，谷歌还开源了一个名为Credentio的本地验证开发库，让开发者更容易地将本地验证机制嵌入到自己的应用程序中。
